content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Alpharetta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and project management education—but no work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or equivalent, you're eligible to begin. This makes CAPM ideal for Alpharetta professionals entering project management roles across technology, fintech, and corporate services sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused schedule, letting you earn your credential while maintaining your current role in Alpharetta's competitive job market.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure all documentation meets PMI's standards before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Take advantage of Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice materials. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—help you master the CAPM content framework so you enter the exam room confident and ready to pass.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew every three years through professional development units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning opportunities to help you stay current, advance your skills, and meet renewal requirements throughout your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
